svg.title: The static_ref header, version 1
svg.text: (a) the fixed part: 16 bytes (integers little endian), and its bytes in this chunk
n_slots = dates × n_static × members = 2 × 5 × 2; then the n_slots records, back to back, no padding
(b) a slot record: 40 bytes (slot 1 of this header), then m bytes for INLINE
sha256 of the slot's float32 little-endian bytes
u8 kind, u8 0, u16 0, u32 arg, 32 bytes sha256
slot 1 = (FIS, date 0, member 1): kind 2 REPEAT, arg = 0, the earlier slot with the same sha256.
kind 0 REFERENCE: arg 0, the values are the sidecar file statics/<sha256>.f4.blosc.
kind 1 INLINE: arg = m > 0, and m bytes follow the record: the numcodecs Blosc frame of the values (zstd 9, bit shuffle).
(c) the 20 slots of the chunk, C order of x[:, static_fields, :, :]
with a store target: 816 bytes = 16 + 20 × 40 (5 REFERENCE, 15 REPEAT)
inline: true: 151 434 bytes = 16 + 20 × 40 + 150 618 of Blosc frames (5 INLINE, 15 REPEAT)
(d) to scale: each header as a bar of its bytes
with a store target: 816 bytes (fixed part, then 20 records)
inline: true: 151 434 bytes; the records are the hairlines, the frames hold the values
frozen (header version 1): every offset and type above, the kind codes 0, 1, 2, the slot order and the
Blosc frame of INLINE data. Not frozen: which kind a slot gets (it depends on the writer's sidecar and cache).
